name: n1-check
description: Step N1 books check: 420 s at MAX (seed 5), the whole dish lit, every N1 part on (pigments from matter, saturation, bleaching, scarce trace from roaming oases, caustics, currents), a mineral spring and a vent; N (60 s); 40 cells placed (80 s); a wash (100 s); a resize (150 s) and back (210 s); each N1 switch off and on again at runtime (120 to 290 s); oases count up and down; G (300 s); a snapshot saved and loaded at once (330 s); atoms and charge rounding must stay 0

evals.js: const v = moire.control.view(); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.3, v.cssH * 0.3, 'heavy', 400); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.5, v.cssH * 0.3, 'light', 400); if (!moire.oases.started) moire.oases.start(); return moire.matter.springs.map(s => s.kind)
return await moire.app.place(Array.from({length: 40}, (_, k) => [150 + 13 * k, 120]), moire.genome.founders[0])
const v = moire.control.view(); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.4, v.cssH * 0.4, 'heavy', 400); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.6, v.cssH * 0.6, 'light', 400); return 'springs again'
moire.pigments.params.matter = true; moire.pigments.params.sat = false; return 'pigments built, no saturation'
moire.pigments.params.sat = true; moire.pigments.params.inhib = false; return 'saturation, no bleaching'
moire.pigments.params.inhib = true; moire.water.params.caustics = false; return 'caustics off'
moire.water.params.caustics = true; moire.water.params.currents = false; return 'currents off'
moire.water.params.currents = true; moire.water.params.speed = 2; moire.water.params.gyre = 2; return 'currents strong'
moire.water.params.speed = 0.35; moire.water.params.gyre = 0.25; moire.oases.params.scarce = false; return 'trace everywhere'
moire.oases.params.scarce = true; moire.oases.params.roam = false; moire.oases.params.count = 6; return 'oases fixed, 6'
moire.oases.params.roam = true; moire.oases.params.count = 2; moire.oases.params.life = 20; return 'oases roam, 2, short lives'
const S = await moire.snapshot({ grid: true }); const r = await moire.loadSnapshot(S); return { exact: r.exact, notes: r.notes, rounding: r.rounding }
